entries.clue: Jewelled band worn above the brow by a bride or a duchess
Stevenson's one-legged sea cook, sharing his name with a precious metal
One who blocks, steams and trims a lady's headwear for the races
Hooded orange outfit, part life raft, worn to get clear of a stricken boat
Small close cover for the crown, as worn by rabbi or pope
Long line of sensors trailed on a cable by a quiet hunter
Given name that goes with 'Jolly' on the black flag
The body of a vessel, bare of her masts, sails, rigging and fittings
Scornful noise forced out through the nose; in British boats, to breathe dived
Unwanted swerve about the vertical, checked by the man steering
Tall-crowned Texan cowboy hat, whose name overstates its capacity
Talking bird perched on the shoulder of every storybook rover
